adjudications.why: Both solvers: D (3 nodes), both MEDIUM, both flagged that counting only the internuclear nodal plane (the usual school answer for a sigma* orbital) gives 1 (A). No key exists. Two defensible answers: owner policy 2026-10-29 case 3, notice, grace.
adjudications.notice: The answer depends on what is counted. Counting the nodal plane between the nuclei together with the radial node carried over from each 2s orbital gives 3 (option D); counting only the nodal plane gives 1 (option A). IISER published no key for 2017. In a PYQ Vault mock this question gives everyone its marks.
